new.title: New suite
new.subtitle: Start from a template. You can add tasks, upload files and lint right after.
new.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'. It becomes the folder name.
new.imageHint: Leave empty to build base/Dockerfile from the template.
new.invalidId: Use lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit.
new.scenario: Comes with a complete sample task
new.notVisible: The suite was written to benchmarks/, but this server reads suites from another folder (benchmarks_root). Ask your server owner to point it at the project's benchmarks/.

templates.python-pytest: Python repo tasks graded by hidden pytest files
templates.node-test: Node repo tasks graded by hidden node:test files
templates.go-test: Go repo tasks graded by hidden go test files
templates.generic-reward: Any task; a test.sh script writes a reward
templates.tool-use: Agent works an HTTP tool server; final state is checked
templates.mcp: Agent works an MCP server; final state is checked
templates.browser: Agent drives a web app through a browser
templates.memory: Multi-session tasks that test the agent's memory
templates.qa: Questions about documents, matched to an answer
templates.external-api: Agent calls an external API, replayed from a cassette
templates.artifact: Graded on the files the agent writes
templates.computer-use: Agent operates a desktop app with screenshots
templates.support: Customer support with a simulated customer
templates.voice: Voice agent talking to a caller

edit.readOnly: Only members can edit suites. Ask an admin of your organization for the member role.
edit.pick: Pick a file on the left to edit it, or add a task.
edit.binary: This file is binary and cannot be edited here. Upload a replacement instead.
edit.tooLarge: Files over 1 MiB must go in a zip.
edit.taskInstruction: Instruction (what a teammate would ask for; never how it is checked)
edit.lockConfirm: Write suite.lock from the files as they are now?
